# AGNA: Applied Graph and Network Analysis

> AGNA is an open-source, headless-capable Java engine and CLI for social network analysis (SNA), sociometry, and graph theory (v2.2.1, Apache-2.0).

## Agent & LLM Documentation
- [Agna for AI Agents](AGENTS.md): Complete guide for AI models, CLI recipes, JSON schemas, error exit codes, and token-saving tips.
- [CLI Reference](docs/cli.md): Full command-line documentation for all 35+ commands.
- [User Manual](docs/manual.md): Comprehensive methodology manual, algorithms, and metric definitions.
- [Quickstart Guide](docs/QUICKSTART.md): Quick introduction for researchers and practitioners.

## Core Capabilities
- **Pre-Flight Validation**: `agna validate <file> --json` (syntax, isolate detection, component analysis, self-loops, diagnostics).
- **Educational Knowledge Base**: `agna explain <metric> --json` (37 metrics with definitions, formulas, and cautious interpretations).
- **Topology-Driven Advisory**: `agna advise <file> --json` (intelligent analysis, layout, and null model recommendations).
- **Narrative Synthesis**: `agna narrative <file> --json` (plain-English synthesis of density, centralization, closure, and reciprocity).
- **Capabilities & Introspection**: `agna capabilities --json` (self-describing manifest of formats, algorithms, and parameters).
- **Native Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: `agna mcp` (in-process JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio server for Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity).
- **Network Summary**: `agna info <file> --json` (nodes, edges, density, reciprocity, connectivity).
- **Token-Efficient Metrics**: `agna metrics <file> <metric> --top N --json` (summary statistics + top-N ranking).
- **Analysis Batteries**: `agna analyse <file> --all` (centrality, clustering, distances, sociometrics, structural holes).
- **Format Conversion**: `agna convert <in> <out>` (Pajek .net, GraphML, GML, GraphSON, UCINET DL, CSV/TSV, Excel, AGN).
- **Graph Transformations**: `agna transform <in> <out> --op <op>` (symmetrize, dichotomize, transpose, ego-network, normalize).
- **Theory & Statistics**: `agna archetype <file> --format json` (small-world, scale-free, core-periphery) and `agna test-null` (Monte Carlo permutation testing).

## Canonical Invocation
```bash
# Run via CLI binary or JAR:
agna <command> [options] FILE
java -jar agna-cli-2.2.1.jar <command> [options] FILE
```
